description: This is a C source file implementing functions for the Slap Loam Broker Object, including dispatching calls, freeing output buffers, and handling events in the context of an SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) system. It handles LPC (Logical Procedure Call) communication scenarios.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboCpcCallDispatch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Dispatches an IMCP SLAP call received via LPC, handling different call types and validating input size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboCpcFreeOutputBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * pOutputBuffer)
methods.description: Releases the memory allocated for an output buffer received from the IPC call.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboCpcNotifyEvent(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles LPC events such as disconnection, performing appropriate cleanup.

ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
